title: Real Research Today: Micro-Credential Exchanges 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Micro-Credential Exchanges 2.0.
description:
The road to Micro-Credential Exchanges 2.0 is already being paved. Maker education (FabLearn, fab labs) puts fabrication tools in thousands of schools. Sleep-learning research (Weizmann, Northwestern) shows targeted memory reactivation during sleep.

Carnegie Mellon's Open Learning Initiative proved adaptive courseware doubles learning rates. Together these programs form the badge standards foundation that Micro-Credential Exchanges 2.0 will build on — the exchange logistics results, the stackability methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as exchange logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Micro-Credential Exchanges 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Micro-Credential Exchanges 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Micro-Credential Exchanges 2.0 — next-gen markets for micro-credentials.

Phase 1 — Prove (badge standards): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (exchange logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (stackability): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (employer signals): exchange hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and learners-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
